events.text: A week of honouring teachers. Students bring gifts to their masters.

effects.log: They are old now, and proud of you.
They keep it on their wall.

events.text: An old master who was cruel to you in your youth asks to see you.

effects.log: He apologises. It means more than you expected.
Some doors stay closed.

events.text: A young fighter asks you to teach them one thing that matters.

effects.log: Everything starts from the feet.
They are annoyed. Years later, grateful.

events.text: Two old masters argue whose students are better. They want a match.

effects.log: A draw. Both masters are secretly relieved.

choices.text: Suggest the students teach the masters

effects.log: A comedy, and an education.

events.text: You hear that an old master who once taught you a few forms has fallen on hard times.

effects.log: They refuse it, then use it for their other students. (−10 taels)
You fix their roof and their spirits.

events.text: An aging master offers to teach you a secret technique, if you promise never to use it in anger.

effects.log: A technique like a closed fist of calm.
The master respects your honesty.

events.text: A fraud teacher is taking silver from poor families' children.

ok.log: One move and his fraud is clear. The families get their silver back.

fail.log: He has one real trick. You still win, bruised.

choices.text: Teach the children for free instead

effects.log: His school empties.

events.text: Young fighters you once coached bring you a gift together.

effects.log: A carved staff with all their names.
The circle continues.

events.text: You bring your village teacher an apple. It has a worm.

effects.log: The teacher laughs and shares it with the worm.
The teacher is touched by the effort.

events.text: A hall with portraits of every master of a forgotten school.

effects.log: Two hundred bows. Your back aches. It feels right.
Every one looks tired and determined.

events.text: An old master says: 'You are good enough to teach. Are you good enough to keep learning?'

effects.log: Humility makes you better.
Teaching teaches the teacher.

events.text: The week of teachers ends with a feast for all the masters of the town.

effects.log: Every master notices you.
Teacups raised to those gone and here.
